description.value: Foy's Irish Bar & Grill is Vancouver's self-described community Irish bar on Kingsway, offering a cozy pub atmosphere with an all-day Irish breakfast menu alongside classic pub fare including soda bread, steak bites, and a rotating soup. The venue hosts a lively weekly events calendar covering live music, traditional Irish music sessions, trivia nights, darts competitions, and pool tournaments. A full lineup of draught beers — including Guinness, Kilkenny, and house-brewed Gaelic Gold — makes it a welcoming stop for cyclists seeking a substantial meal or a pint after a ride.
